title: Non-Blocking Init with {continue, Term}, handle_continue/2 & Periodic handle_info/2 Timers
solutionExplanation: Uses {continue, hydrate_defaults} for instant start_link supervisor unblocking and erlang:send_after/3 timer ticks in handle_info to sweep expired sessions.

otpDocCards.description: Starts a timer which sends Msg to Dest after TimeMs milliseconds.
otpDocCards.complexityNote: O(log N) timer wheel insertion in ERTS runtime.

otpDocCards.description: Returns the current OS system time in the requested time unit.

mentalModelCheck.question: Why does returning {ok, State, {continue, Term}} prevent supervisor boot timeouts?

options.label: start_link returns immediately to the supervisor, while handle_continue runs before any mailbox messages are processed.
options.explanation: Correct! The supervisor unblocks in microseconds, while OTP guarantees that handle_continue/2 runs before any client calls or casts in the process mailbox.

options.label: continue spawns a separate OS thread to execute the code.
options.explanation: No OS threads are spawned; handle_continue runs in the same Erlang process.

options.label: continue disables all timeouts permanently in the BEAM runtime.
